rules.title: 2026 Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026. The AGA is set at 65% of the increase in the Bay Area Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers.
rules.key_value: 1.0% (65% of the increase in the CPI for All Urban Consumers in the Bay Area, July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025)
rules.coverage_text: Units with permanent rent ceilings under the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board, for eligible landlords meeting the conditions in Regulation 1148.
rules.exemptions: The 2026 AGA may not adjust rents of tenants whose tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rents were set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
rules.citation: Rent Board Regulation 1148; Berkeley Municipal Code section 13.76.110A.
rules.quoted_span: At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025, the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
rules.interaction_text: The 2026 AGA may not adjust tenants’ rents when their tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025, and who had their rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
